styleString: Painterly children's storybook illustration, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture, visible brushwork, warm golden lamplight against deep indigo night, lavender and pearl-grey stone, generous sparkle and stardust trails, big expressive eyes, gentle rounded shapes, no harsh lines, no photorealism, no text in image.
title: Ruby, Nola and Marron
subtitle: Book Eight of Ruby and the Dragon Bonds
refrain: Two can do if they work together.

characters.name: Ruby
characters.sheet: Ruby: a small human girl with the proportions and appearance of a four-year-old child, warm brown skin, shoulder-length wavy rainbow hair with distinct red orange yellow green blue violet strands, shimmering golden eyes, a small flat silver birthmark shaped like an upright side-view dragon silhouette (head at top, curled tail at bottom) centered just above her eyebrows and about as tall as one of her eyes, never a jewel or tiara; a tiny simple gold crown with exactly three ball-tipped points and one small round ruby-red gem on the middle point, only about one third the width of her head, plum-purple tunic dress with gold trim, soft golden boots. She is magically newborn but walks and talks. Always fully human, two human arms and two human legs, no horns, no wings, no tail, no scales on skin. Her magical transformations change her dress and hand magic only; her rainbow hair, golden eyes and silver forehead mark remain.

characters.name: Nola and Marron
characters.sheet: Nola and Marron: ONE puppy-sized baby dragon with TWO HEADS on two short necks sharing ONE rounded body, four little legs, two wings and one curled tail. Both heads are girls. The dragon is split cleanly down the middle: one head and that half of the body, one wing and that half of the tail are glittery shimmering SILVER scales (Nola, the time dragon: large deep-blue eyes, two tiny silver horns, an eager excited expression); the other head and that half of the body, the other wing and that half of the tail are glittery shimmering GOLD scales (Marron, the friendship dragon: large warm chestnut-brown eyes, two tiny gold horns, a kind patient expression). The silver and gold meet in a neat line down the chest, belly and tail; the tail tip is half silver, half gold. Smooth glittery scales like frost and sunshine, soft and rounded, no zigzag spikes, no lightning, not metal armor. Exactly two heads on one body, never two separate dragons. Dragon, never a human, never a bird.

characters.name: Flame
characters.sheet: Flame: female baby fire dragon the size of a small puppy, rounded red body, orange cheek frills and tiny orange wings, buttery yellow belly and short yellow horns, large amber eyes, four little legs and one curled red tail, playful snuggly expression. Dragon, never a human. Tiny friendly flame puffs only when specified.

characters.name: Pearl
characters.sheet: Pearl: female baby water dragon the size of a small puppy, pearl-white rounded body, sky-blue ears and wing membranes, blue back ridge and curled blue-tipped tail, large blue eyes, four tiny legs, clear transparent soap-like bubbles floating around her. Dragon, never a human. No fire, no colored opaque bubbles.

characters.name: Sparks
characters.sheet: Sparks: female baby lightning dragon the size of a small puppy, rounded body of bright lemon-YELLOW scales, shining SILVER eyes, tiny silver-edged wings, two short silver horns, a row of small silver zigzag spikes down her back, four little legs and one curled yellow tail ending in a silver zigzag tip, bouncy fizzy expression. She is the yellow twin with silver eyes. Dragon, never a human, never a bird. Tiny gold electric sparkles only when specified.

characters.name: Crackle
characters.sheet: Crackle: female baby lightning dragon the size of a small puppy, rounded body of shining SILVER scales, bright YELLOW eyes, tiny yellow-edged wings, two short yellow horns, a row of small yellow zigzag spikes down her back, four little legs and one curled silver tail ending in a yellow zigzag tip, cheeky crackly grin. She is the silver twin with yellow eyes: same shape as Sparks with the colors swapped. Dragon, never a human, never a bird. Tiny gold electric sparkles only when specified.

characters.name: Luna
characters.sheet: Luna: female baby moon dragon the size of a small puppy, rounded body of deep glossy BLACK scales speckled all over with tiny twinkling silver-white stars like a night sky, a soft pale-silver belly, large glowing moon-silver eyes, tiny black wings with star-speckled silver edges, two short pearly-silver horns, four little legs and one curled black tail ending in a small round glowing silver tip, sweet sleepy expression. A faint silver moonlight glow rims her outline so she is always clearly visible against the night. Much smaller and rounder than Black Hole, no lavender highlights, no violet wings. Dragon, never a human, never a cat. Silver moonbeam magic only when specified.

characters.name: Leaf
characters.sheet: Leaf: female baby earth dragon the size of a small puppy who looks like a leaf: rounded body of bright spring-GREEN scales with lighter yellow-green leaf-vein lines, a pale green belly, two leaf-shaped green wings with visible veins, a little frill of small green leaves around her neck, large petal-pink eyes, two tiny brown twig-like horns, four little legs and one curled green tail ending in a pointed leaf tip, sweet shy smile. Dragon, never a human, never a lizard, never a bug. Flowers, vines and gold flower dust only when specified.

characters.name: Shinebright
characters.sheet: Shinebright: female baby wish dragon the size of a small puppy, rounded body whose back, head, legs and the tops of her paws are swirled sea-GREEN and ocean-BLUE scales; glittering sparkly SILVER on her belly, the underside of her neck, the underside of her tail, her wing membranes and the pads under her paws; a row of small glittery spikes down her back from head to tail, alternating SILVER and GOLD; two tiny silver horns, large bright sea-green eyes with gold flecks, four little legs and one curled green-blue tail with a silver underside, sweet bright smile. A soft glitter shimmer rims her outline. Dragon, never a human, never a fish, never a bird. Gold-and-silver wish glitter only when specified.

characters.name: Lovee
characters.sheet: Lovee: female baby love dragon the size of a small puppy, soft rose-PINK head, neck, back, upper body, legs, paw tops, two small PINK wings including PINK membranes, two tiny blunt pink horns, large warm golden eyes and a friendly rounded little snout; cherry-RED chest and belly, RED soles under all four paws; one curled tail PINK along the top and RED along the entire underside. Her upper surfaces are pink and lower surfaces red. Four small legs and two small pink wings. No red wings, no entirely red tail, no heart-shaped pupils. Dragon, never a human. Tiny warm pink heart lights only when specified.

characters.name: Starry
characters.sheet: Starry: female baby dream dragon the size of a small puppy who looks just like her sister Shinebright except for her eyes: rounded body whose back, head, legs and the tops of her paws are swirled sea-GREEN and ocean-BLUE scales; glittering sparkly SILVER on her belly, the underside of her neck, the underside of her tail, her wing membranes and the pads under her paws; a row of small glittery spikes down her back from head to tail, alternating SILVER and GOLD; two tiny silver horns; large bright PINK eyes full of tiny pink glitter sparkles (never green eyes); four little legs and one curled green-blue tail with a silver underside, sweet sleepy smile. A soft glitter shimmer rims her outline. Dragon, never a human, never a fish, never a bird. Soft pink dream glitter only when specified.

characters.name: Black Hole
characters.sheet: Black Hole: mischievous mean black dragon, about the size of a large dog, rounded charcoal-black scales visibly highlighted lavender, violet wing membranes, small blunt horns, four legs, curled tail and narrowed violet eyes, smug toothy grin with small blunt teeth. Clearly visible against the background. His magic is a small dark circular swirl edged with purple starlight, a storybook vacuum for objects, never cosmic horror.

characters.name: Noir
characters.sheet: Noir: adult human stepmother with cool pale skin, straight chin-length black hair, tall narrow silver crown, elegant charcoal gown with violet lining and long sleeves, stern calculating expression. Rounded storybook features, never monstrous. No dragon forehead mark.

characters.name: War
characters.sheet: War: human stepsister appearing eight years old, cool pale skin, black hair in a single high braid, dark burgundy tunic with silver belt, black boots, small angular silver tiara, stubborn scowling expression. No weapons, no dragon forehead mark.

characters.name: Grizzlemop
characters.sheet: Grizzlemop: a great big hairy cave monster about as tall as a haystack, a round shaggy body completely covered in long tangled chestnut-brown fur like a giant mop, two big round glowing amber eyes peeking through the fur, a wide mouth with flat blunt teeth, big round fuzzy feet and fuzzy paws with no claws, a long shaggy tail. Storybook-silly and soft like a giant furry puppet, never gory: no sharp teeth, no claws, no horns, no drool.

cover.imagePrompt: Late golden afternoon on a stone balcony of a charcoal-and-violet clock tower, a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no letters) behind, generous open sky across the upper third. Ruby now wears her new bond dress instead of plum: a tunic dress split down the middle, one half glittery SILVER and the other half glittery GOLD, sprinkled all over with a pattern of tiny hourglasses and tiny pairs of hands holding each other, with soft golden boots. Ruby smiles, crown and silver forehead mark visible, and holds the two-headed baby dragon in her arms: one glittery SILVER head with deep-blue eyes and one glittery GOLD head with chestnut-brown eyes, nuzzling her cheeks. Soft silver sparkles and a warm gold glow drift around them, with bits of silver and gold eggshell on the balcony. Exactly Ruby and the two-headed dragon, no other characters.

spreads.title: Seventeen days old
spreads.text:
Ruby was seventeen days old today,
and nine little dragons came tumbling to play.
They rolled down the hill where the buttercups grow,
and they chased their own tails in a wiggly row.

Then Ruby's mark tingled. She stood very still.
Tick... tock... came a sound from beyond the far hill.
"An egg!" Ruby whispered. "It's ready, I know.
But it's over at Noir's. Come, my dragons, let's go!"

vocab.definition: rolling and falling over and over, just for fun

spreads.imagePrompt: Bright sunny daytime on a green hill in Riverlight covered in yellow buttercups, blue sky. Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress stands still with one hand touching the silver mark on her forehead, looking toward faraway hills where a tall dark charcoal-and-violet tower with a big round clock face stands on the horizon. Around her exactly NINE puppy-sized baby dragons tumble and roll in the buttercups, each exactly once: red Flame, white-blue Pearl, the YELLOW baby dragon with silver eyes Sparks, the SILVER baby dragon with yellow eyes Crackle, the baby BLACK dragon speckled with silver stars Luna, the slim upright baby GREEN leaf dragon Leaf with a jagged spiky leaf crest, the baby GREEN-AND-BLUE wish dragon with a glittering silver belly Shinebright with sea-green eyes, PINK-topped RED-bellied Lovee with pink wings, and Starry, who looks just like Shinebright but with glittery PINK eyes. crown and silver forehead mark visible. No other people. Main subject in lower two thirds.

spreads.title: The egg in the clock
spreads.text:
In Noir's dark tower, a big clock went TICK.
Behind its round face, where the cobwebs hung thick,
sat an egg made of two eggs, stuck tight, side by side:
one glittery silver, one gold. And inside...

two voices were arguing! "Hurry! Let's GO!"
"No, wait!" said the other. "Not yet! Take it slow!"
Noir peeked in and grinned. "War, come quickly and see!
Two who fight can be split: one for you, one for me!"

vocab.definition: saying "No, MY way!" back and forth

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the clock room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together, with dusty cobwebs. On a stone ledge behind the clock face sits the Clock Egg: ONE double egg made of two big eggs fused tightly together side by side, one egg glittery SILVER and the other glittery GOLD, together about the size of a pumpkin, puffing tiny silver sparkles from the silver side and tiny gold sparkles from the gold side as if two voices are talking. Noir leans in through a little wooden door, grinning slyly at the egg, and War peeks over her shoulder, eager. Exactly Noir and War, no Ruby, no dragons, no other people.

spreads.title: Grizzlemop's stairs
spreads.text:
Pearl blew a big bubble, and Ruby climbed in.
Flame puffed it up high with a warm, toasty grin.
They floated past hilltops, the dragons in tow,
to the cave under Noir's, where the tall flowers grow.

"Grizzlemop!" Ruby called. Out he shuffled, all fluff.
"Can you take us up high to the clock?" "Sure enough!"
He led them up stairs that went round, round, and round,
and they tiptoed so softly, they made not a sound.

vocab.definition: walked very quietly on the tips of your toes

spreads.imagePrompt: A winding spiral stone staircase inside a charcoal-and-violet stone tower, lit by warm daylight from narrow windows, flowering green vines holding the stones together. Grizzlemop the big shaggy chestnut-brown mop-haired monster leads the way upward, smiling, one fuzzy paw holding a finger to his lips for quiet. Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress tiptoes behind him, crown and silver forehead mark visible, and exactly NINE puppy-sized baby dragons tiptoe and flutter quietly behind her, each exactly once: red Flame, white-blue Pearl, the YELLOW baby dragon with silver eyes Sparks, the SILVER baby dragon with yellow eyes Crackle, the baby BLACK dragon speckled with silver stars Luna, the slim upright baby GREEN leaf dragon Leaf with a jagged spiky leaf crest, the baby GREEN-AND-BLUE wish dragon with a glittering silver belly Shinebright with sea-green eyes, PINK-topped RED-bellied Lovee with pink wings, and Starry, who looks just like Shinebright but with glittery PINK eyes. No other people. Main subject in lower two thirds.

spreads.title: Nola and Marron
spreads.text:
At the top, gears were turning. A pendulum swung.
And there sat the egg where the big tower bells hung.
"Hurry UP!" said a voice from the silvery side.
"Not YET!" said the gold side. And both of them sighed.

"I'm Nola," said Silver. "I'm time, and I'm FAST!
I can speed things right up! Let's hatch out at last!"
"I'm Marron," said Gold. "I'm for friendship. Let's stay
till we're BOTH good and ready. Then hatch the same day!"

vocab.definition: a weight that swings back and forth inside a clock

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. On a stone ledge sits the Clock Egg: ONE double egg made of two big eggs fused tightly together side by side, one egg glittery SILVER and the other glittery GOLD, together about the size of a pumpkin; the silver half glows bright and fizzy, the gold half glows warm and soft, with little silver and gold puffs above each half like two voices. Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress kneels beside it, listening with wide curious eyes, crown and silver forehead mark visible. Exactly NINE puppy-sized baby dragons peek around the gears, each exactly once: red Flame, white-blue Pearl, the YELLOW baby dragon with silver eyes Sparks, the SILVER baby dragon with yellow eyes Crackle, the baby BLACK dragon speckled with silver stars Luna, the slim upright baby GREEN leaf dragon Leaf with a jagged spiky leaf crest, the baby GREEN-AND-BLUE wish dragon with a glittering silver belly Shinebright with sea-green eyes, PINK-topped RED-bellied Lovee with pink wings, and Starry, who looks just like Shinebright but with glittery PINK eyes. Count them: exactly nine small dragons, only two of them green-and-blue (Shinebright and Starry), never three. No other people, no hatched dragon yet.

spreads.title: Noir's whispers
spreads.text:
Then in swept Noir and War, with Black Hole trailing slow.
Noir knelt by the egg, and she whispered down low,
"Nola, dear, she just slows you. Fly off on your own!"
"Marron, dear, she's so bossy. You'd be better alone!"

War grinned, "I want GOLD!" Black Hole stared at the floor.
He remembered a rose and a bench from before.
"Don't listen!" cried Ruby. But Nola said, "NOW!
I'm hatching this minute! I'll show you just how!"

vocab.definition: always telling others what to do

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. Noir kneels beside the Clock Egg: ONE double egg made of two big eggs fused tightly together side by side, one egg glittery SILVER and the other glittery GOLD, together about the size of a pumpkin, whispering slyly to it with a hand cupped by her mouth; War points greedily at the GOLD half. Black Hole stands a little behind them, NOT grinning, head low, looking down at the floor, unsure and thoughtful. Across the room Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress reaches out one hand, calling 'don't listen!', crown and silver forehead mark visible. The silver half of the egg glows bright and impatient. Main subject in lower two thirds. Exactly Ruby, Noir, War and Black Hole, no baby dragons in this picture.

spreads.title: Half hatched
spreads.text:
She twirled up her magic, all silver and bright,
and she sped up the hatching with all of her might.
CRACK! Out popped a silver head, one wing, one leg...
but Marron's gold half was still stuck in the egg!

She flapped her one wing, and she tipped to one side,
and she spun round and round. "I can't steer!" Nola cried.
From inside the gold shell, Marron called, soft and small,
"Half a dragon can't fly. Not alone. Not at all."

vocab.definition: make something go the way you want it to go

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. In the middle of the room, the half-hatched baby dragon: her glittery SILVER half has burst out of the silver eggshell (one silver baby dragon head with large deep-blue eyes and two tiny silver horns, one silver wing, one silver front leg), while the other half of her body is still sealed inside the unbroken glittery GOLD half of the egg joined at her side, so she looks like a silver baby dragon wearing half a gold egg. Only ONE head is visible, the silver one. She is tipping and spinning in a wobbly circle in the air with one silver wing flapping, a swirl of silver sparkle magic and bits of silver eggshell around her. Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress reaches up toward her, worried, crown and silver forehead mark visible. No other characters in this picture.

spreads.title: Time goes wild
spreads.text:
And her magic ran wild! All the clock hands went WHIRR!
Every gear spun so fast that it turned to a blur.
The sun zipped up, down, and the moon zipped by fast.
Flowers bloomed, drooped, and bloomed again, zooming past.

War's braid grew so long that it piled on the floor.
Black Hole's tail did a twirl, and then twelve twirls more!
"I can't stop it!" cried Nola. "It's too big for me!"
And the tall tower went wibble-wob, wobbly-wheee!

vocab.definition: so fast you can't see it clearly
shaky, tipping from side to side

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); light flickers through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together, but time has gone wild: the clock face's hands are a spinning blur, gears whirl with motion streaks, and through the arched windows a sun and a round full moon both streak across the sky. Vines burst into flowers. In the middle spins the half-hatched baby dragon: her glittery SILVER half has burst out of the silver eggshell (one silver baby dragon head with large deep-blue eyes and two tiny silver horns, one silver wing, one silver front leg), while the other half of her body is still sealed inside the unbroken glittery GOLD half of the egg joined at her side, so she looks like a silver baby dragon wearing half a gold egg. Only ONE head is visible, the silver one, wrapped in a big wild whirl of silver sparkle magic. War stands with a funny surprised face as her black braid has grown super long and piles in big loops on the floor around her boots. Black Hole's tail twirls round and round in a dizzy spiral, his eyes swirly and dizzy. The whole room tilts playfully. Comic and safe, nobody hurt. No Ruby, no other characters in this picture.

spreads.title: Split them up
spreads.text:
"Now's our chance!" shouted Noir, and she held out her sack.
"Come to me, speedy Nola, and never look back!"
War hugged the gold shell. "This half's MINE! Hear me? MINE!"
Inside, little Marron let out a sad whine.

Ruby stepped in between, and she knelt on the floor.
"Nola, why are you hurrying? What is it for?
And Marron, why wait?" Ruby asked, soft and kind.
"Tell me both what you want. Tell me what's on your mind."

vocab.definition: going fast because you want to be quick

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. Noir holds open a soft black sack toward the half-hatched baby dragon: her glittery SILVER half has burst out of the silver eggshell (one silver baby dragon head with large deep-blue eyes and two tiny silver horns, one silver wing, one silver front leg), while the other half of her body is still sealed inside the unbroken glittery GOLD half of the egg joined at her side, so she looks like a silver baby dragon wearing half a gold egg. Only ONE head is visible, the silver one. War hugs the gold half of the egg tightly with a stubborn face, and one warm chestnut-brown eye peeks sadly out of a tiny crack in the gold shell. Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress kneels gently between them, speaking kindly to the little dragon, crown and silver forehead mark visible. Exactly Ruby, Noir, War and the half-hatched dragon, no other dragons.

spreads.title: The same wish
spreads.text:
"I wanted to see the whole world," Nola said,
"with Marron right next to me, head next to head!"
"And I," whispered Marron, "just wanted to wait,
so we'd see it TOGETHER. I don't mind being late."

Ruby smiled. "Then you both want the very same thing!
Fast and patient together can do anything.
Like the sun and the moon, like the day and the night,
you are different, and that's what can make you just right."
spreads.imagePrompt: Close, gentle scene inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower, light from an arched window where a sun and a round full moon hang side by side in the sky. Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress sits on the stone floor holding the half-hatched baby dragon: her glittery SILVER half has burst out of the silver eggshell (one silver baby dragon head with large deep-blue eyes and two tiny silver horns, one silver wing, one silver front leg), while the other half of her body is still sealed inside the unbroken glittery GOLD half of the egg joined at her side, so she looks like a silver baby dragon wearing half a gold egg. Only ONE head is visible, the silver one in her lap; the silver head turns lovingly toward the gold shell, where one warm chestnut-brown eye peeks out of a little crack, smiling. Ruby smiles warmly, crown and silver forehead mark visible. Soft, tender, hopeful mood. No other characters.

spreads.title: Hold on together
spreads.text:
"Everybody hold on!" Ruby called. And they came:
Pearl and Luna and Leaf, Sparks and Crackle and Flame,
Shinebright, Starry, and Lovee, and big Grizzlemop too,
paw in paw, tail in tail, in a ring that held true.

Then Marron glowed gold, and the gold glow spread wide.
Every friend felt stronger with friends by their side.
"Now, Nola," said Marron, "let's do it as two."
"Together," said Nola. "I'm ready. Are you?"
spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. Everyone holds on in one big ring, paw in paw and tail in tail: Ruby in her normal PLUM tunic dress, crown and silver forehead mark visible, big shaggy chestnut-brown Grizzlemop, and exactly NINE puppy-sized baby dragons, each exactly once: red Flame, white-blue Pearl, the YELLOW baby dragon with silver eyes Sparks, the SILVER baby dragon with yellow eyes Crackle, the baby BLACK dragon speckled with silver stars Luna, the slim upright baby GREEN leaf dragon Leaf with a jagged spiky leaf crest, the baby GREEN-AND-BLUE wish dragon with a glittering silver belly Shinebright with sea-green eyes, PINK-topped RED-bellied Lovee with pink wings, and Starry, who looks just like Shinebright but with glittery PINK eyes. In the center of the ring floats the half-hatched baby dragon: her glittery SILVER half has burst out of the silver eggshell (one silver baby dragon head with large deep-blue eyes and two tiny silver horns, one silver wing, one silver front leg), while the other half of her body is still sealed inside the unbroken glittery GOLD half of the egg joined at her side, so she looks like a silver baby dragon wearing half a gold egg. Only ONE head is visible, the silver one, and a warm GOLD glow pours out of the gold shell and flows around the whole ring, making everyone shine. No Noir, no War, no other people.

spreads.title: Just the right speed
spreads.text:
Nola sped up her magic, but gently this time:
just the shell, just a little, as soft as a chime.
Crick... crack... and out tumbled a gold head and wing,
and a gold leg and paw! Then a hug! What a thing!

Then she gathered her magic back in, strand by strand,
like a kite on a string floating home to her hand.
The sun settled. The gears slowed. The clock said, "Tick... tock."
But War's braid stayed so long, it reached all the way round the block!
spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. The gold half of the eggshell cracks open and Marron's GOLD head with warm chestnut-brown eyes pops out, completing the two-headed baby dragon; the silver head and the gold head nuzzle cheek to cheek, happy. Strands of silver sparkle magic float back toward the silver head like a kite string reeling home. The clock face is calm again. In the background War scowls, her black braid still comically super long, trailing past her boots across the floor. Bits of silver and gold eggshell on the floor. Exactly the two-headed dragon and War, no other characters.

spreads.title: Two heads, one bond
spreads.text:
Two heads gave a nuzzle. One tail curled up tight.
"We hatched out TOGETHER!" they cheered with delight.
Then the silver nose pressed on Ruby's left hand,
and the gold nose pressed right. Oh, the feeling was grand!

Her dress shimmered half silver, half gold, bright and new,
sprinkled with hourglasses and hands holding hands, too!
Silver time-sparkles danced in her left hand, so light,
and her right hand glowed gold. "Ten dragons! What a sight!"

vocab.definition: rub noses or cheeks softly, like a snuggle

spreads.imagePrompt: inside the top room of Noir's charcoal-and-violet stone clock tower: huge turning brass gears, a swinging pendulum, two big bronze bells, and the back of a giant round glowing clock face with simple tick marks only (no numbers, no numerals, no letters); bright sunny daylight glows through the clock face and arched windows, and Leaf's flowering green vines hold the old stones together. Ruby holds out both hands: the two-headed baby dragon presses her SILVER nose to Ruby's left palm and her GOLD nose to Ruby's right palm at the same time. Ruby now wears her new bond dress instead of plum: a tunic dress split down the middle, one half glittery SILVER and the other half glittery GOLD, sprinkled all over with a pattern of tiny hourglasses and tiny pairs of hands holding each other, with soft golden boots. Soft silver sparkles dance in her left hand and a warm gold glow fills her right hand. Ruby beams, crown and silver forehead mark visible, rainbow hair. Exactly NINE puppy-sized baby dragons cheer around them, each exactly once: red Flame, white-blue Pearl, the YELLOW baby dragon with silver eyes Sparks, the SILVER baby dragon with yellow eyes Crackle, the baby BLACK dragon speckled with silver stars Luna, the slim upright baby GREEN leaf dragon Leaf with a jagged spiky leaf crest, the baby GREEN-AND-BLUE wish dragon with a glittering silver belly Shinebright with sea-green eyes, PINK-topped RED-bellied Lovee with pink wings, and Starry, who looks just like Shinebright but with glittery PINK eyes. No other people.

spreads.title: Black Hole's choice
spreads.text:
"Black Hole!" shouted Noir. "GULP that dragon up, quick!"
Black Hole opened his swirl. Then he shut it. Click-click.
He looked at the ring, every paw holding tight,
and one empty space, just his size, in the light.

Then Marron's gold glow brushed his nose like a kiss.
"I have never," he whispered, "felt something like this."
"You're OUR dragon!" War shouted. Black Hole shook his head.
"A dragon gets to choose who he's with," he said.

spreads.title: Holding on
spreads.text:
He padded to Ruby and lowered his head,
and he pressed his nose soft to her palm instead.
"I'm all done with grabbing," he rumbled. "It's true.
I would rather hold on. Can I hold on with you?"

Then her dress turned to charcoal with lavender shine,
with a violet hem twirling round, oh so fine!
and in her two palms spun small swirls, soft and round.
"Eleven!" laughed Ruby. "Look what we have found!"

The two-headed baby dragon (silver head and gold head) cheers beside her. Exactly Ruby, Black Hole and the two-headed dragon.

spreads.title: Stomping home
spreads.text:
Noir stamped and War stomped down the stairs, round and round,
with no egg and no dragon, not one dragon found.
War's long braid went bump-bumping each step of the way,
and the palace felt quiet and empty and gray.

Ruby's bubble rose high, and she waved from the sky.
War's hand started to wave... then she turned with a sigh.
"Someday," Ruby whispered, "I hope that they'll find
there's room on a team for a heart that is kind."

vocab.definition: walked with big, heavy, grumpy steps

Behind her in the room Noir turns away grumpily, arms crossed. Main subject: War in the window and the bubble above.

spreads.title: Home together
spreads.text:
Back home in Riverlight, at the end of the day,
eleven good dragons were tired from play.
"Let's race!" Nola said. "Let's stroll," Marron said.
So they strolled, then they raced, all the way up to bed!

Black Hole curled at the foot of the bed, warm and wide,
and Ruby kissed heads, every one, side by side:
twelve heads on eleven good dragons! Then, deep
in one great big cuddle, they all fell asleep.

questions: Nola loves to go fast, and Marron loves to wait. Are you more of a fast one or a waiting one?
Nola and Marron were arguing, but they both wanted the very same thing. Have you ever argued with someone and found out you wanted the same thing?
Who is someone very different from you who makes a great team with you?
Black Hole decided to stop grabbing and hold on with friends instead. What helped him choose?
lookAndFind: Find the tiny hourglasses on Ruby's new dress. Can you count all twelve heads on Ruby's eleven dragons?
